translations.Copy these values into the SAML settings: Copy these values into the SAML settings of every service you connect (step 3 above).
translations.Delete service \"{name}\"? Users will no: Delete service "{name}"? Users will no longer be able to log in there via Nextcloud.
translations.E-mail address of the user (most common): E-mail address of the user (most common)
translations.Each entry is one external service that: Each entry is one external service that users can log in to with their Nextcloud account.
translations.Entity ID (= your Nextclouds name as IdP: Entity ID (= your Nextclouds name as IdP) — also serves as metadata URL
translations.Extra security: verify the service (opti: Extra security: verify the service (optional but recommended)
translations.It lets people log in to other services: It lets people log in to other services (like Kimai, GitLab or Grafana) with their Nextcloud account. Nextcloud acts as the "identity provider" (IdP) - the central place that checks passwords. Each external service is a "service provider" (SP) that trusts Nextcloud to confirm who someone is.
translations.Many services can import everything auto: Many services can import everything automatically from this URL.
translations.Name: Name
translations.Nextcloud signs every login confirmation: Nextcloud signs every login confirmation with this certificate so services can verify it is genuine. Copy the single-line version into services that ask for an "x509 certificate" (e.g. Kimai).
translations.No certificate generated yet - SAML logi: No certificate generated yet - SAML logins will not work until you click the button below.
translations.No services are configured yet. Ask your: No services are configured yet. Ask your administrator.
translations.Optional - only if the service offers lo: Optional - only if the service offers logout
translations.Really regenerate? All services must the: Really regenerate? All services must then be given the new certificate.
translations.Regenerate certificate (all connected se: Regenerate certificate (all connected services must be updated afterwards!)
translations.Reject login requests from this service: Reject login requests from this service unless they are cryptographically signed (needs the services certificate above)
translations.Server error (status {status}). See the: Server error (status {status}). See the Nextcloud log for details.
translations.Service added - now tell the service abo: Service added - now tell the service about Nextcloud (see step 3 above).
translations.The address in the service where Nextclo: The address in the service where Nextcloud sends users after login. Find it in the services SAML settings (often ends in /saml/acs).
translations.The services own certificate (PEM). Only: The services own certificate (PEM). Only needed if the service signs its login requests.
translations.Username, display name and e-mail are al: Username, display name and e-mail are always sent. Here you can add more names the service expects, e.g. {"groups": "uid"}. Available values: uid = username, displayName = full name, mail = e-mail.
translations.What the service receives as the users u: What the service receives as the users unique name. "E-Mail address" is right for most services.
Where the service sends users to log in.
translations.You need two things from the services SA: You need two things from the services SAML settings: its "Entity ID" (its unique name) and its "ACS URL" (login callback address). For example Kimai: Entity ID = https://kimai.example.com/auth/saml/metadata, ACS URL = https://kimai.example.com/auth/saml/acs
